result.markdown:
# Accessibility Degradation on S-SFX-001 and S-SFX-007

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-SFX-001`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of configuration changes on the affected sites immediately preceding the accessibility degradation, backed by detector alerts and minor RRC failure alarms. The maintenance calendar and external events were NOT CHECKED via tool call.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-05 03:50 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-05 03:52
- **Affected:** S-SFX-001, S-SFX-007

## Summary

Configuration change CHG-2026-0008 pushed to S-SFX-001 (and CHG-2026-0009 to S-SFX-007) at 03:52 introducing regression in admission control and RRC timers.

Poor accessibility with dropped rrc_success_pct and spiked drop_rate_pct starting at 03:50 on S-SFX-001 and S-SFX-007, ongoing at 08:36.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-05 03:45: Anomaly ANM-000048 (drop_rate_pct spike) and ANM-000049 (rrc_success_pct drop) started on S-SFX-001. [ANM-000048, ANM-000049, ALR-0002]
- 2026-09-05 03:52: Configuration change CHG-2026-0008 pushed RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to S-SFX-001, and CHG-2026-0009 pushed to S-SFX-007. [CHG-2026-0008, CHG-2026-0009]
- 2026-09-05 04:25: Minor alarm ALM-000073 (RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH) raised on S-SFX-007. [ALM-000073]
- 2026-09-05 04:27: Minor alarm ALM-000074 (RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH) raised on S-SFX-001. [ALM-000074]

## Evidence

- S-SFX-001 and S-SFX-007 experienced drops in rrc_success_pct and spikes in drop_rate_pct starting around 03:45 to 03:50. [ALR-0002, ANM-000048, ANM-000049]
- Configuration changes CHG-2026-0008 and CHG-2026-0009 pushed RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to S-SFX-001 and S-SFX-007 at 03:52. [CHG-2026-0008, CHG-2026-0009]
- Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarms were raised on both affected sites shortly after the configuration push. [ALM-000073, ALM-000074]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-SFX-001: confirmed. Configuration changes CHG-2026-0008 and CHG-2026-0009 pushed parameter template RT-2.4 affecting admission control and RRC timers precisely matching the onset of accessibility degradation. [CHG-2026-0008, CHG-2026-0009, ALR-0002]
2. **capacity** at S-SFX-001: rejected. PRB utilization remains very low during the window, ruling out traffic congestion. [RB-CONGESTION#03]

## Ruled out

- RB-CONGESTION#03: PRB utilization is very low, ruling out congestion.

## Recommended actions

- Rollback configuration changes CHG-2026-0008 and CHG-2026-0009 to restore previous RRC and admission control parameters.

## Sources

- `ANM-000048`: S-SFX-001 drop_rate_pct spike, ongoing since 2026-09-05 03:45
- `ANM-000049`: S-SFX-001 rrc_success_pct drop, ongoing since 2026-09-05 03:45
- `ALR-0002`: ongoing alert from 2026-09-05 03:45: 2 site(s) (S-SFX-001, S-SFX-007); region-level SFX; metrics: drop_rate_pct, rrc_success_pct
- `CHG-2026-0008`: config_push on S-SFX-001 at 2026-09-05 03:52: Push RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to S-SFX-001 (admission control, RRC timers) [in effect (not rolled back)]
- `CHG-2026-0009`: config_push on S-SFX-007 at 2026-09-05 03:52: Push RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to S-SFX-007 (admission control, RRC timers) [in effect (not rolled back)]
- `ALM-000073`: minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH on S-SFX-007, raised 2026-09-05 04:25, active
- `ALM-000074`: minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH on S-SFX-001, raised 2026-09-05 04:27, active
- `RB-CONGESTION#03`: Radio capacity congestion > Differential diagnosis: ### Versus a stadium event or other expected demand An event also brings users, high PRB and `HIGH_PRB` a...

## Verification notes

- Confidence lowered from high to medium: not checked: the maintenance calendar, external events.
